name: Nike Zoom Kobe 5 Protro 'X-Ray'
story_html: The Nike Zoom Kobe 5 Protro 'X-Ray' updates the retro silhouette with a glow-in-the-dark X-ray graphic depicting a skeletal foot. A deep royal blue synthetic upper is equipped with a padded mesh collar and integrated Flywire cables for midfoot lockdown. The cushioning setup features a lightweight Cushlon midsole with a responsive Zoom Air unit in the forefoot. Multi-directional traction is provided by a blue-tinged translucent rubber outsole that glows in the dark.
